storylines.title: Bryson Warren, Pistons Sign Exhibit 10 Contract
storylines.summary: The Detroit Pistons signed guard Bryson Warren to an Exhibit 10 contract. Detroit's G League affiliate, the Motor City Cruise, recently acquired Warren's G League rights. Following the NBA preseason, Warren is expected to join the Cruise for the G League season. Warren played in 28 G League games for the Westchester Knicks last season. The 6-foot-3 guard averaged 18.8 points, 2.8 rebounds, 4.9 assists and 1.2 steals per game.
